guarantees.claim: The output entropy_configured_o is driven by the instance u_entropy_configured of prim_mubi4_sender, which connects .mubi_o to entropy_configured_o and .mubi_i to entropy_configured, operating synchronously (AsyncOn=0).

assumptions.claim: The EDN bus width must equal the width of the ENTROPY_SEED register because this module does not perform width adaptation.
assumptions.cond: when EDN data is used to seed entropy
assumptions.risk: Data truncation or misalignment leading to incorrect entropy seed values.

uncertain_points.claim: The block comment states an assertion about EDN bus width versus ENTROPY_SEED width, but no actual SystemVerilog assertion is implemented in this chunk.
uncertain_points.risk: If parameter mismatches go unchecked, the design may silently produce incorrect entropy seeds, potentially weakening security.
